matches.rationale: Led a three-year enterprise technology transformation across 14 business units, exceeding the eight-unit scope.
Tracked a $140M, 60-program portfolio, larger than the $90M required.
Built and ran a Transformation Management Office with quarterly value reporting to the executive team and had board audit committee exposure, though direct board value reporting is not stated.
Led organizations of up to 320 people as a manager of managers, exceeding the 120-person scope.
Has executive exposure to the COO, though a direct COO reporting line is not stated.
Has executive exposure to the CIO and CTO and consolidated 9 delivery organizations, indicating operating-model change work.
Drove transformation across 14 business units and an AI program spanning finance and support, reflecting cross-functional leadership.
Has 18 years in leadership across enterprise software and fintech, though only part of that is explicitly large-scale transformation.
Governed a 60-program portfolio with quarterly value reporting to executives and exposure to the CIO, CTO, COO and board audit committee.
Built a Transformation Management Office, stood up an AI enablement program and launched a developer platform from scratch.
